text:
emily: Quick Q — for an ongoing incident I need the raw request body for event_id `evt_9a3f2`. Do our audit logs ever include the full request_body? If not, who can approve a one-off unmask and what's the retention on any unmasked copy?
sasha: Short answer: we DON'T keep raw request bodies in the main audit table by default. We store `request_body_hash` + a redacted `masked_body`. Raw bodies are only accessible via the emergency unmask pipeline. :lock:
aj: Unmask workflow exists but requires an approval chain: security lead + legal signoff. The unmasked payload is placed into a short-lived secure bucket and TTL'd for 7 days. Typical turnaround ~1–3 hours depending on approvals.

kai: For clarity, the archived event exports (analytics path) are parquet with columns: `event_id`, `actor`, `action`, `ts`, `meta` (json). They don't contain `raw_request_body`. If you need to reference it for debugging, use the unmask flow.

emily: OK — what's the exact request I should open and who do I tag?
sasha: Open an internal ticket in `#sec-requests` or create a Jira `SEC-AUD-` ticket. Include: event_id, reason, scope, and retention requested. Tag `@sasha` and `@legal`. Example request body in ticket:```
Event IDs: ["evt_9a3f2"]
Reason: PII leak triage — need original payload for reproduction
Retention: 7 days (default emergency)
Approval: security_lead + legal
```

aj: Also include whether you need a copy or just temporary view. Copy goes to `s3://audit-ephemeral/unmasked/<ticket-id>/` with server-side encryption and KMS. Views are logged and not exported.

emily: Can someone confirm the CLI/SQL to look up the hashed reference while I open the ticket?
kai: Use the psql view `audit.audit_with_hashes_vw`. Example:```
SELECT event_id, request_body_hash, masked_body
FROM audit.audit_with_hashes_vw
WHERE event_id = 'evt_9a3f2';
```

legal: Quick note — Legal needs the justification + list of people who will see the raw body. We require that no copies be shared outside the ticket unless explicitly approved.

audit-bot: Reminder — per policy, emergency unmask requests must include: 1) incident ticket link, 2) retained duration <= 14 days, 3) approver list. Missing items delay approval. :warning:
emily: Got it. I'll open `SEC-AUD-247` with the details and ping you both. Thanks. :thumbsup:
sasha: Thanks — if you need faster triage ping me in the thread and I can escalate to the oncall. :eyes:
